limits: Owner combined API/handler XML is retained, not independently rerun. This review covers the API module and accepted observer interaction, not a new handler implementation review.
A current result certifies a recent original ledger observation, not unchanged database contents after that read.
Actual candidate timings, live counts and any endpoint routing are separate owner evidence.

review_findings.finding: Parent identified a cached-reader response that could survive a concurrent integrity invalidation followed by source restoration.
review_findings.resolution: Both cached and refresh paths now check the captured generation under the final response lock.

review_scope: Read-only source review; no independent test rerun, live input reads, evaluation, runtime integration or source edits.
verified_boundaries: Exact separately pinned specification, registry, activation, primary selection and all 23 source identities are rechecked for each response.
Cache owns immutable canonical report bytes, has one refresh at a time, preserves original ledger observation clocks and rejects observed source/integrity failures.
Final locked integrity-generation gate covers both cached and refreshing responses, including invalidate-and-restore concurrency.
Consumer-time eligibility only expires original targets; it preserves original decision, forecast hash, cohort and observer report rather than issuing forecasts.
Partial ledgers and unavailable current input readiness remain explicit; old producer envelopes are diagnostic only.
